meta.title: Configuration for Event: Leaving required selections empty throws validation errors

steps.note: Open the existing saved draft; without a title, the runner selects a suitable draft and reopens its create screen.
Open the RFQ configuration window from the draft.
Confirm the requested configuration window is displayed before changing its required selections.

args.goal: in the buyer session, clear or deselect every mandatory radio option that the Configuration for Event window permits, click Save, and record the validation result or resulting state shown by the window

steps.note: Perform and observe the configuration validation interaction that no dedicated catalog step can express.
Assert the resulting screen has no crash, server error, raw error data, or other rendering failure after the validation attempt.
